# Bootskills Academy — #1 Tech & Business Training in Kigali, Rwanda
> Bootskills is Rwanda's leading practical training platform offering tech, business, and financial literacy courses with real-world projects and internships. Based in Kigali, Rwanda. Serving all of Africa.
> Website: https://bootskills.com
> Location: Kigali, Rwanda
> Founded: 2024 by Manzi Alain Patrick Munyeshuri and Bizimana Eric
